theme.rationale: Medical and financial applications demand trust, calm, and stability. Dark mode can feel too clinical or 'crypto-bro'. This grounded approach creates a clear, premium, and stress-free environment for young professionals.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous spacing. Mobile-first hierarchy with bento-style cards. Tap-friendly interactive areas.
layout_and_spacing.cardStyles: bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-[#E5E5E5] p-6

components.navigation: Bottom tab bar with distinct selected state (active icon in brand.primary, inactive in text.secondary). No top hamburger menu.
components.buttons: Large touch targets (min 48px height). Primary: bg-[#1A4331] text-white rounded-xl. Secondary: bg-[#E8F3ED] text-[#1A4331] rounded-xl.
components.inputs: NativeWind compatible styling: bg-white border border-[#E5E5E5] rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-base text-[#1A1A1A].
components.charts: Compact, curved line charts or simple progress rings. Hide grid lines to reduce visual clutter.
components.aiInsightsCard: Special bento card. bg-[#FAEFEA] border border-[#CC5A3A]/20. Use a sparkle icon and deep terracotta text for actionable AI prompts.

motion_and_interaction.screenTransition: Slide from right or subtle fade-in.
motion_and_interaction.microInteractions: Use subtle haptic feedback for significant actions like categorizing expense or saving a goal.

accessibility.contrast: All text must pass WCAG AA. Ensure brand primary against white is readable.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a testID or data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

userProfile.description: Young Indian doctor smiling. Use for profile avatar.

aiHeaderBackground.description: Abstract smooth organic shapes. Use as a subtle background behind the AI insights card or header (opacity 10-20%).

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a React Native Expo app. You MUST use React Native components (View, Text, ScrollView, TouchableOpacity, etc.) and NativeWind (Tailwind for React Native) for styling.
Implement bottom tab navigation utilizing Expo Router or React Navigation.
Do NOT use HTML elements (div, span).
Ensure all buttons, inputs, and interactive cards have `testID` props (or data-testid if on web) for robust testing.
The AI insight card should feel conversational and warm. Use the 'aiHeaderBackground' image subtly behind it if possible.
Use standard React Native Chart libraries like `react-native-chart-kit` or `react-native-svg-charts` for the hospital revenue and leakage data.
Apply 'font-Manrope' to headings and 'font-WorkSans' for body text, ensuring they are loaded via Expo fonts.
